cliomicplot Session Summary

Source: SESSION_SUMMARY.md

Date: 2026-07-06

Request

Improve visibility and visual polish across the cliomicplot R package plots.

Main Changes

  • Fixed cliplot() so each plot type’s preprocessing function runs before drawing.
  • Added forwarding for range aesthetics such as xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax, and extra_data.
  • Improved the base package theme with stronger text hierarchy, clearer axes, better panel borders, and cleaner legends.
  • Added a new showcase theme for presentation-ready plots.
  • Updated default qualitative/sequential/diverging palette settings.
  • Improved common plot defaults for points, bars, lines, histograms, densities, boxplots, and violins.
  • Improved specialized plot types:
    • Volcano: shaded significant regions, stronger thresholds, better labels and legend visibility.
    • MA: separate up/down significant colors, clearer log-scale x-axis, improved LOESS styling.
    • PCA: larger outlined points, filled ellipses, optional centroids, clearer labels.
    • Swimmer: converted bars to true timeline segments and improved event marker rendering.
    • Waterfall: corrected response classification defaults and added PD/PR threshold labels.
    • Heatmap: made row/column scaling actually apply and improved diverging colors.
    • Correlation: improved tile borders, coefficient contrast, and significance handling.
  • Regenerated roxygen documentation into man/.
  • Regenerated NAMESPACE.
  • Added required LICENSE file for MIT + file LICENSE.
  • Updated package metadata and build hygiene:
    • Added Author and Maintainer.
    • Removed unused RColorBrewer import.
    • Removed LazyData because there is no data/ directory.
    • Added build ignores for .gitignore, source tarballs, and Rplots.pdf.

Validation

  • Runtime smoke test passed for:
    • points
    • boxplot
    • volcano
    • MA
    • PCA
    • waterfall
    • swimmer
    • correlation
  • Built source tarball with:
    • R CMD build --no-build-vignettes cliomicplot
  • Checked built tarball with:
    • R CMD check --no-manual --no-build-vignettes --ignore-vignettes cliomicplot_0.1.0.tar.gz
  • Final check result: Status: OK

Notes

  • The workspace is not a git repository, so no commit was created.
  • Generated check directories and the parent-directory temporary tarball were cleaned up after validation.
